name: MonarchPresenceAvatars
title: PresenceAvatars
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet and androidx.compose.material3.ListItem, with MonarchAvatarGroup and MonarchAvatar
summary: Who is here now: an overlapping stack of avatars with presence dots and a "+N" tile, opening a bottom sheet that lists everyone with their presence and activity.
whenToUse: In the header of a shared document, board or call, to show who else is here now and what they are doing.
whenNotToUse: Not for a static list of assignees or members; use MonarchAvatarGroup. Not for one person's presence; use MonarchAvatar with a status.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchPresenceAvatars(people: List<MonarchPresencePerson>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, maxVisible: Int = 4, size: MonarchAvatarSize = MonarchAvatarSize.Sm, onPersonClick: ((MonarchPresencePerson) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchPresenceAvatarsLabels = MonarchPresenceAvatarsLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

public class MonarchPresencePerson(id: String, name: String, image: Painter? = null, seed: String? = null, status: MonarchPresenceStatus = MonarchPresenceStatus.Online, customStatus: String? = null, activity: String? = null)

public class MonarchPresenceAvatarsLabels(label: ((Int) -> String)? = null, showAll: String? = null, list: String? = null, done: String? = null, more: ((Int) -> String)? = null, person: ((name: String, presence: String, activity: String?) -> String)? = null)

options.name: people
options.description: Who is here, most relevant first. Nothing is drawn while it is empty.

options.name: maxVisible
options.description: At most this many avatars, then a "+N" tile. With exactly one too many, every avatar is shown.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the avatars in the stack: 24, 32 or 40dp.

options.name: onPersonClick
options.description: Makes the stack open the list and every person in the list a button, for example to jump to their cursor. The list closes first.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: label, showAll, list, done, more and person.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The interaction source of the stack when it opens the list.

states.name: all shown
states.description: Every avatar is visible and the stack is not a button; each avatar is read on its own.

states.name: overflow
states.description: A "+N" tile ends the stack and the whole stack is a button that opens the list.

states.name: tappable
states.description: With onPersonClick the stack opens the list and every row in it is a button.

states.name: list open
states.description: A modal bottom sheet with the title "Everyone here", a Done button, and one row per person: a 40dp avatar with its presence dot, the name, and the presence with the custom status and activity.

appearance: Avatars with a ring in the surface color and presence dots in their presence colors; the "+N" tile on the muted background with muted text. In the list, names in the default text color and the second line in the muted text color, on the sheet's surface, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web opens a popover from the "+N" button and makes each avatar a button. On Android, as on iOS, overlapping 24dp avatars cannot each be a 48dp touch target, so the whole stack is one button that opens a Material 3 ModalBottomSheet, and people are chosen in that list. The callback keeps the web name onPersonClick, where iOS says onPersonTap. The web adds the initials shown on an avatar to the button's name for voice control; Android voice access reads the content description, which names each person in full. The presence words are the built-in strings of MonarchPresenceDot.
accessibility: A stack that does not open the list is a group named "5 people here"; its avatars are images named "Ana Silva, Online, Editing".

A stack that opens the list is one button named "6 people here: Ana Silva, Online, Editing; Ben Okafor, Away · In a meeting; …; 3 more", with the click action "Show everyone here" and a 48dp touch target.
Presence is always spoken with the custom status, so it never depends on the dot color.
In the list the title is a heading, each row is one element with the same text, and with onPersonClick each row is a button at least 48dp high.
Avatars and text grow with the font size setting; long names and activities wrap in the list.
edgeCases: An empty list of people draws nothing.
With one person more than maxVisible, every avatar is shown instead of a "+1" tile.
A maxVisible below zero shows the "+N" tile alone.
An activity that is empty or white space is left out.
Long names and activities wrap in the list; the list scrolls in the sheet.

examples.title: In a document header
examples.template:
MonarchPresenceAvatars(
    people = listOf(
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = {{people.0.id}}, name = {{people.0.name}}, activity = {{people.0.activity}}),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = {{people.1.id}}, name = {{people.1.name}}, activity = {{people.1.activity}}),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = {{people.2.id}}, name = {{people.2.name}}, status = status({{people.2.status}})),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = {{people.3.id}}, name = {{people.3.name}}, status = status({{people.3.status}}), customStatus = {{people.3.customStatus.emoji}} + " " + {{people.3.customStatus.text}}),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = {{people.4.id}}, name = {{people.4.name}}, status = status({{people.4.status}})),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = {{people.5.id}}, name = {{people.5.name}}),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = {{people.6.id}}, name = {{people.6.name}}, status = status({{people.6.status}})),
    ),
)
examples.setupTemplate:
fun status(web: String): MonarchPresenceStatus =
    when (web) {
        "away" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Away
        "busy" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Busy
        "dnd" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.DoNotDisturb
        "offline" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Offline
        else -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Online
    }
examples.setup:
fun status(web: String): MonarchPresenceStatus =
    when (web) {
        "away" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Away
        "busy" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Busy
        "dnd" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.DoNotDisturb
        "offline" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Offline
        else -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Online
    }
examples.code:
MonarchPresenceAvatars(
    people = listOf(
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u1", name = "Priya Raman", activity = "Editing"),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u2", name = "Tom Becker", activity = "Viewing"),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u3", name = "Lee Park", status = status("away")),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u4", name = "Ana Silva", status = status("busy"), customStatus = "📅" + " " + "In a meeting"),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u5", name = "Ben Okafor", status = status("dnd")),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u6", name = "Sam Ito"),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u7", name = "Mia Novak", status = status("offline")),
    ),
)

examples.title: Jump to a person's cursor
examples.code:
MonarchPresenceAvatars(
    people = listOf(
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u1", name = "Ana Silva", activity = "Viewing slide 4"),
        MonarchPresencePerson(id = "u2", name = "Ben Okafor", customStatus = "In a meeting"),
    ),
    onPersonClick = { following = it.id },
)
